# Data Processing Addendum

Between Kadamba Fit Private Limited and Kadamba Fit Ireland Limited (each a controller for its own members) and Mailwren Ireland Limited, Dublin (processor). Signed by all parties on 11 June 2025.

## Processing

- Subject matter: sending transactional email
- Data: email address, first name, message content
- Duration: the term of the service agreement
- Location: EU members on eu-west-1 (Dublin), India members on ap-south-1 (Mumbai)

## Processor obligations

Mailwren:

1. acts only on the customer's documented instructions
2. binds its staff to confidentiality
3. applies the security measures in Annex II, including encryption in transit and at rest
4. engages sub-processors only with 30 days' prior written notice and on the same terms (list in Annex III)
5. helps the customer answer data subject and Data Principal requests
6. helps with security, DPIAs and breach reporting, and tells the customer of a personal data breach within 24 hours
7. deletes or returns all data within 30 days of the end of the service
8. provides the information needed to show compliance and allows audits

## Transfers

Mailwren Inc. (USA) can access EU member data only for support escalations. That access runs under the 2021 Standard Contractual Clauses, Module 3, between Mailwren Ireland Limited and Mailwren Inc., with a transfer impact assessment at Annex IV.
